title: TCBI Announces Operating Results for Q3 2026
summary: TCBI announced operating results for the third quarter of 2026.
body_markdown:
**DALLAS** - October 21, 2026 - Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (TXSE: TCBI), the parent company of Texas Capital Bank, announced operating results for the third quarter of 2026.


“Third quarter results exemplify a steadily improving, and increasingly diversified earnings profile, supported by a business model intentionally built to be resilient to market and rate cycles,” said Rob C. Holmes, Chairman, President & CEO. “We continue to effectively serve and grow our client base, leveraging our unique capabilities to support sustained momentum across the platform, despite the challenging economic backdrop.”
